lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-luminance circular spots arranged in approximately five horizontal rows posterior to the branchial slits, forming a quasi-rectilinear grid across the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect the horizontal spot rows, with circular blobs frequently positioned at the nodes of this grid-like pattern.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent longitudinal ridges are visible, exhibiting sharp vertical pixel intensity gradients characterized by a high-luminance upper edge and a shadowed lower margin.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Approximately five high-luminance blobs are visible within the silhouette of the first dorsal fin, arranged in a non-uniform spatial distribution.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: The apex of the first dorsal fin displays an irregular, jagged profile and notched posterior margin indicative of previous physical trauma.
other_distinctive_markers: Multiple elongated, high-contrast silhouettes representing commensal fish (Echeneidae) are visible trailing the pectoral fin and along the ventral-lateral region.
